intro.title: A recruitment partner built on trust and results.
intro.body: We connect qualified workers with international employers and help companies recruit the right people for their business — handling everything from sourcing and screening to visa processing and deployment.

categories.title: Workers across every trade.
categories.subtitle: Skilled, semi-skilled, and general workers ready for overseas deployment.

one.title: Register
one.body: Workers register and submit their CV; employers share their requirements.

two.title: Screen & test
two.body: We screen candidates, verify documents, and arrange skills or trade testing.

three.title: Interview
three.body: We coordinate interviews between employers and shortlisted candidates.

four.title: Deploy
four.body: Visa processing, orientation, and travel — we handle deployment end to end.

why.title: Why companies and workers choose us.

one.title: Licensed & compliant
one.body: A registered recruitment agency operating under a valid recruiting licence.

two.title: Transparent process
two.body: Clear steps and honest communication at every stage — no hidden surprises.

three.title: Worker safety first
three.body: We prioritise the wellbeing and fair treatment of every worker we deploy.

four.title: Fast deployment
four.body: Streamlined screening and documentation to get workers on-site sooner.

about.title: A trusted overseas recruitment partner from Bangladesh.
about.intro: {company} is a BAIRA-member recruitment agency operating under Recruiting Licence {licence}. We help qualified workers find overseas employment and help international employers recruit reliable, suitable workers — handled end to end from our office in Banani, Dhaka.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To provide reliable, transparent, and responsible recruitment services for workers and international employers alike.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To become a trusted workforce recruitment partner in the international employment market.

honesty.title: Honesty
honesty.body: Straightforward dealings with workers and employers at every step.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Clear processes and costs — no hidden surprises.

professional.title: Professional service
professional.body: Trained staff and organised, efficient handling of every file.

safety.title: Worker safety
safety.body: The wellbeing and fair treatment of every worker we deploy comes first.

satisfaction.title: Employer satisfaction
satisfaction.body: The right workers, matched to each employer's real requirements.

leadership.title: Guided by experience
leadership.quote: Our commitment is simple — treat every worker with respect and deliver every employer the right people. That trust is what we have built {company} on.

office.title: Where it all happens
office.body: Our Banani office houses reception, processing, a candidate waiting area, and interview rooms — a professional environment for workers and visiting employers.

services.title: End-to-end recruitment services
services.intro: From first registration to safe arrival abroad, and from worker sourcing to post-deployment support — we handle the full journey for both job seekers and employers.
